campaign.pickMission: Pick a point on the map
campaign.lostBody: The darkness counter reached {value}: the rite of the eternal night is complete, the campaign is over.
campaign.lostRosterBody: The druzhina has fallen: no fighter survived. The campaign is over.

darkness.title: The Darkness grows
darkness.text: Every mission feeds Koschei's ritual: the Darkness counter rises after both victory and defeat. If it reaches the limit, the eternal night falls before the Needle is found.

scan.title: Scanning
scan.text: Hidden map points are revealed by scanning from the Flying Ship. A scan costs one herb and opens every point within the radius.

wound.title: Wounds
wound.text: A fighter who finishes a mission at low health is wounded: aim, defense and mobility suffer. Heal them in the Infirmary — the tab at the bottom of the screen.

roster.title: The Warband
roster.text: This is your warband. A fallen fighter is lost forever; a recruit gains a class after two victories — the Sage wields panic, illusion and ally teleportation.

forge.title: The Forge
forge.text: The Forge crafts equipment for gold and herbs: weapons and charms. A crafted item is equipped during deployment and affects the next battle.

deploy.title: Deployment
deploy.text: Choose from one to five fighters — only they will enter the battle. The wounded carry penalties, the equipped carry weapons and charms from the Forge.

evacuation.title: Extraction zone
evacuation.text: The cells along the western edge are the extraction zone. A fighter standing there may leave the field with a special action: the rescued or the scout counts as survived.

general.title: General of Nav
general.text: This is no common foe: a General of Nav wields special powers. Kill him for good — his escape threshold lets him flee at low health and return in another mission.

first_battle.title: First battle
first_battle.text: Click a highlighted cell to move, click an enemy to attack with the main weapon. The "End turn" button on the right passes the turn to Nav. Newcomers are advised to finish the Training in the main menu first.

first_leshy.title: Leshy
first_leshy.text: The Leshy keeps its distance and shoots from afar, while its roots entangle the target — an immobile fighter cannot move. Close in and strike point-blank.

first_kikimora.title: Kikimora
first_kikimora.text: The Kikimora poisons — the poison ticks at the start of a turn — and raises fallen skeletons. Remove poison with the Znaharka's skill and kill the skeletons again.

training.title: Training
training.hint: Three missions teach the basics. Go in order or pick any.

movement.title: First steps
movement.description: Grid, levels, pits, action points, movement and dash.
movement.intro: The training deck of the Flying Ship. Let us start with the basics: the grid, the levels and action points.
movement.hint1: Each fighter has action points. A move costs one, a dash costs two.
movement.hint2: Move to the highlighted cell: a normal step costs one action point. On this step only that cell is open.
movement.hint3: End your turn with the button on the right.
movement.hint4: Nice step! Now the dash: move to the highlighted far cell — a move for two action points at once.
movement.hint5: End the turn with the button on the right — a new turn begins.

combat.title: Combat
combat.description: Attack, cover, height, hit chance and damage.
combat.intro: Against Nav bravery alone is not enough: height, cover and a careful aim decide the outcome.
combat.hint1: The Bogatyr's weapons: the sword is quicker, the mace is stronger. The lesson starts with the sword — its button glows on the panel.
combat.hint2: The upyr hides behind cover. Step into the highlighted cell next to it: from the side cover does not help, and from above height wins.
combat.hint3: Strike the upyr with the sword: the weapon button and the target glow. An attack spends the remaining points — end the turn and repeat until the upyr falls.

skills.title: Skills & statuses
skills.description: Class skills, overwatch, poison and resurrection, summons, fog of war.
skills.intro: Three against Nav: the Bogatyr strikes, the Znaharka heals and summons, the Strelets shoots from afar. Try skills, the stance and overwatch.
skills.hint1: The Znaharka summons a forest beast: pick the highlighted skill, then the highlighted cell beside her.
skills.hint2: The Strelets stands watch (key 0): he will answer an enemy entering his sector. The fog of war hides everything out of sight.
skills.hint3: End your turn — and watch what Nav can do.
skills.notePoison: A fighter is poisoned! The poison ticks at the start of a turn — cleanse it with the Znaharka's skill.
skills.noteResurrect: The Kikimora raised a skeleton! Kill it again.
skills.noteSummon: The Znaharka summoned a forest beast: it fights for you and fades after a few turns.
skills.hint4: The Bogatyr is poisoned: the venom ticks at the start of a turn. The Znaharka will cleanse it — the skill and the target glow.
skills.hint5: The Bogatyr takes the defensive stance (key 9): while Nav strikes, the stance reduces the damage.
skills.hint6: The Strelets strikes from afar: the bow glows, the target is the framed Kikimora. Range and height decide.
skills.hint8: The Znaharka heals the most wounded: the skill and the target glow.
skills.hint9: Finish Nav off: follow the highlight — the Chronicler will point out every strike. The Kikimora may raise the upyr — slay it again.

over.victoryBody: The Chronicler writes the deed into the ship's chronicle.
over.defeatBody: Try again — the chronicle awaits its next chapter.

training.exitHint: Abandon training and return to mission selection.
training.allDoneHint: All three missions are done. The Chronicler is pleased — the Quick Match awaits you.
training.resetHint: Completed mission marks will be cleared.
